1044.description: Pinch a weight plate between your fingers and thumb and hold it. It builds finger and thumb grip strength.
instructions: Pick up two smooth plates and stack them with the smooth sides facing out.
Pinch them together with your fingertips and thumb.
Stand tall with your arm hanging by your side.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without letting the plates slip.
Switch hands and repeat.

1108.description: You curl your body up toward your hands with the straps at head height, a bodyweight biceps builder.
instructions: Hold the handles with palms up and lean back with arms extended.
Keep your body straight from head to heels.
Bend your elbows and pull your hands toward your ears.
Keep elbows high and out to the sides.
Squeeze the biceps at the top.
Lower with control until the arms are straight.

1172.description: A push-up with extra load and assistance so you can adjust difficulty while keeping good form.
instructions: Get into a plank with hands under your shoulders and load placed on your upper back.
Brace your core and keep your body in a straight line.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up until your elbows are straight.
Use the assistance as needed to keep every rep clean.

1236.description: A one-arm row with your free hand braced on a rack for support. It lets you pull heavy while keeping your back steady.
instructions: Place one hand on a rack or sturdy support and hinge forward with a flat back.
Hold a dumbbell in your other hand with your arm hanging.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1300.description: A machine press that travels along a decline path. It focuses on the lower chest and triceps in a fixed, stable motion.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly lower the handles back towards your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅高度和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，直到双臂完全伸展。
慢慢地将手柄放回胸部，保持肘部稍微弯曲。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将手柄推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1364.description: Stand and tilt your pelvis back and forth to move your lower back. It loosens the lower back and teaches pelvic control.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Place your hands on your hips or let them hang by your sides.
Engage your core muscles and tilt your pelvis forward, pushing your lower back towards the wall behind you.
Hold the position for a few seconds, then release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
将双手放在臀部或垂在身体两侧。
调动核心肌肉并向前倾斜骨盆，将下背部推向身后的墙壁。
保持该位置几秒钟，然后松开并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1428.description: Hold your arms out and move your wrists in slow circles. It warms up the wrist joints and forearm muscles.
instructions: Extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Make a fist with both hands.
Rotate your wrists in a circular motion, keeping your arms still.
Continue the wrist circles for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将双臂伸直在身前。
双手握拳。
以圆周运动旋转手腕，保持手臂静止。
继续手腕转圈达到所需的重复次数。

1492.description: A stretch for the back of the upper arm, taken with the elbow bent overhead.
instructions: Stand or sit tall and raise one arm overhead.
Bend the elbow so your hand drops behind your head.
Use your other hand to gently press the elbow back and down.
Keep your ribs down and avoid arching your back.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch arms.

1556.description: A stiff-legged deadlift with dumbbells while standing on a bench for extra depth. It targets the hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Stand on a sturdy bench holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs.
Keep your knees nearly straight and push your hips back.
Lower the dumbbells down your legs and below the bench level with a flat back.
Pause when you feel a deep hamstring stretch.
Squeeze your glutes to return to standing.

1620.description: A one-arm hammer press on an incline with an exercise ball. It works the triceps and adds a balance challenge.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball with a dumbbell in one hand.
Walk your feet forward and roll your body down until your head, neck, and upper back are supported on the ball.
Hold the dumbbell with your palm facing inward and your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Press the dumbbell up towards the ceiling, straightening your arm.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，一只手拿着哑铃。
双脚向前走，身体向下滚动，直到头部、颈部和上背部得到球的支撑。
握住哑铃，手掌朝内，肘部弯曲成 90 度角。
将哑铃向上推向天花板，伸直手臂。
将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1684.description: A single leg step up combined with a bicep curl. It trains the biceps, glutes and balance.
instructions: Stand in front of a step or platform with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot on the step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Engage your core and push through your right heel to lift your body up onto the step, bringing your left knee up towards your chest.
At the top of the movement, perform a bicep curl by bending your elbows and bringing the dumbbells towards your shoulders.
Lower the dumbbells back down and simultaneously lower your left foot back to the ground.
Repeat the movement on the opposite side, stepping up with your left foot and curling the dumbbells.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站在台阶或平台前，每只手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝向身体。
将右脚放在台阶上，确保整个脚与表面接触。
启动核心并推动右脚跟，将身体抬起到台阶上，将左膝抬向胸部。
在动作的最高点，弯曲肘部并将哑铃拉向肩膀，进行二头肌弯举。
将哑铃放回原处，同时将左脚放回地面。
在另一侧重复该动作，左脚向上并弯举哑铃。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

1748.description: A lying close-grip extension with an EZ bar, lowering the bar behind your head. Puts strong focus on the long head of the triceps.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold the ez barbell with a close grip, palms facing up, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，头放在长凳的末端。
紧紧握住 ez 杠铃，手掌朝上，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持上臂静止，弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1812.description: Kneeling on all fours and rotating through your trunk mobilises and stretches your mid back. Slow and controlled works best.
instructions: Start on your hands and knees with your hands under your shoulders.
Place one hand behind your head and rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1876.description: Plate-loaded machine raise that targets the side of the shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the seat and place your arms against the pads.
Sit upright.
Raise your arms out to the sides until about shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly to the start.

1940.description: A seated stretch pulling the foot toward the chest to open the hips and buttocks.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your back tall and legs extended.
Bend one knee and hold the foot and shin.
Pull the foot gently toward your chest while keeping your spine upright.
Feel the stretch deep in the buttock and hip.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2324.description: A cable hinge with straight legs that trains the glutes and hamstrings.
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and stand facing away from the stack.
Reach through your legs and grab the rope, then step forward to add tension.
Keep your legs nearly straight and hinge forward at the hips.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall while the rope passes between your legs.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Hinge back with control and repeat.

2708.description: A grip and pull contest with a stick, building grip strength and total body tension.
instructions: Sit facing a partner with feet against theirs and both hands on a stick.
Brace your core.
Pull the stick toward you with a strong grip.
Resist your partner while keeping your back straight.
Keep the effort steady and control the end of each pull.

2772.description: Rotating the thigh inward at the hip, working the muscles that turn the leg in.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg outward, which rotates the hip inward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2836.description: A straight-leg hinge from a raised box for a longer range on the hamstrings.
instructions: Stand on a step box facing a low cable and hold the handle.
Keep your knees nearly straight.
Hinge at the hips and lower the handle.
Keep your back flat.
Squeeze your glutes to stand.

2900.description: A preacher style curl performed standing at an angled pad. Isolates the biceps with strict form.
instructions: Stand facing a preacher pad and hold an EZ bar with an underhand grip.
Rest your upper arms on the pad with the arms extended.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until the arms are almost straight.

2964.description: A glute bridge with the barbell resting on your hips and your hands on the bar. It builds the glutes and hamstrings with load.
instructions: Sit on the floor with a barbell over your hips, padded if needed.
Roll back, set your feet, and hold the bar with both hands.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower slowly and repeat.

3092.description: A squat followed by a high knee drive as you stand. It combines leg strength with a cardio push.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down with your chest up.
Drive up through your feet to stand.
Lift one knee toward your chest as you reach the top.
Lower the foot and go back into the squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

3156.description: A standing, bent-over one arm row with a close grip, working the muscles between and around the shoulder blades. A light handheld weight keeps the pull honest.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in one hand with a neutral grip.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲，一只手握住哑铃，握姿中立。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将哑铃向上拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体并将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

3220.description: A jump from a squat that ends with the legs spread wide, like a jumping jack with a squat start. It raises the heart rate and trains the legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees and lower your body into a squat position.
Jump explosively upwards, extending your legs and arms.
While in the air, spread your legs apart and bring your arms out to the sides.
Land softly with your feet shoulder-width apart, bending your knees to absorb the impact.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
弯曲膝盖并将身体降低至蹲姿。
爆发性向上跳跃，伸展双腿和手臂。
在空中时，将双腿分开，并将双臂向两侧伸出。
双脚分开与肩同宽，轻轻落地，弯曲膝盖以吸收冲击力。
重复所需的重复次数。

3348.description: A plank on an incline where you tap each shoulder, building core and shoulder stability.
instructions: Place your hands on a bench or box and extend into a plank position.
Spread your feet slightly wider for balance.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder.
Keep your hips level and body in a straight line.
Alternate sides at a steady pace.

3412.description: Squeeze your glutes while lying down to activate them before heavier lower body work.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and lift your hips slightly.
Hold the squeeze for 2 seconds.
Lower your hips without relaxing completely.
Repeat for 12-15 reps.

3476.description: A lying stretch with a spinal twist to open the hips and back.
instructions: Lie on your back and pull your knees in.
Drop both knees to one side.
Keep your shoulders on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the center.
Switch sides.
Kneel on all fours.
Place one hand behind your head.
Rotate your elbow up toward the ceiling.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to start.
Switch sides.

3668.description: A dumbbell press performed lying on the floor, which limits the range of motion and is easy on the shoulders.
instructions: Lie on the floor holding dumbbells above your chest.
Lower them until your upper arms touch the floor.
Pause briefly.
Press back up to straight arms.
Keep your wrists straight.

3732.description: A curtsey lunge holding a kettlebell at your chest. It targets the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest and stand tall.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Push through your front heel to return.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

3796.description: A squat while holding the band out in front of you against sideways pull. It trains your legs and anti-rotation core strength.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the handle with both hands at your chest, then press it straight out.
Keep your hips and shoulders square as you squat down.
Stand back up while holding the band steady.
Complete your reps, then turn around and repeat on the other side.

3860.description: A rowing movement holding a weight plate, good for the mid back and for grip strength.
instructions: Hold a weight plate firmly with both hands at its edges.
Hinge forward at the hips with a flat back and slightly bent knees.
Let the plate hang below your chest with arms extended.
Pull the plate toward your lower ribs, keeping your elbows close.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.
Keep your hips still and your neck neutral.

3924.description: A floor fly sliding hands on towels for a bodyweight chest isolation move.
instructions: Kneel or get into a plank with your hands on towels.
Slide your hands out wide to the sides.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Squeeze your chest to slide your hands back together.
Keep your core tight.
Do not let your hips sag.

3988.description: A reverse grip curl done chest down on an incline bench. It targets the forearms and brachialis.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a barbell overhand.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Curl the bar up.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower fully with control.

4052.description: Rope waves from a half kneeling stance. It raises the heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot forward and hold a rope end in each hand.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Make fast alternating waves with your arms.
Keep the rhythm steady for a set time.
Switch the front leg for the next set.

4116.description: A wide stance deadlift variation using a very wide grip, training hips and back.
instructions: Stand with a wide stance and hold the bar with a wide grip.
Set a flat back and chest up.
Drive through your feet to lift.
Lock out your hips at the top.
Lower the bar with control.

4180.description: A seated pullover using a cable. It isolates the lats with constant tension.
instructions: Sit at a high pulley holding the rope or bar with straight arms.
Lean slightly forward.
Pull the handle down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly with arms straight.
Avoid bending your elbows.

4244.description: Walking while holding a kettlebell locked out overhead. It builds shoulder stability, core control and grip.
instructions: Clean and press a kettlebell overhead with one arm.
Lock out your elbow with the bell stable.
Stand tall with your ribs down.
Walk forward with slow, controlled steps.
Keep your wrist straight and avoid leaning.
Lower the bell and repeat on the other arm.

4372.description: A low plank-like yoga pose held just above the floor. It strengthens the core and arms.
instructions: Lie face down with palms under your shoulders.
Tuck your toes and lift your body.
Lower into a low plank with elbows tucked in.
Keep your body straight and hold for 20-30 seconds.
Lower to the floor.

4436.description: A low-impact move stepping one leg out at a time, raising your heart rate while working the legs.
instructions: Stand with feet together and hands in front of your chest.
Step one foot out to the side.
Bring it back and step the other foot out.
Keep your knees slightly bent.
Keep a steady rhythm for 30-60 seconds.

4500.description: Moves between a plank and downward dog. Builds core strength and opens up the hamstrings and shoulders.
instructions: Start in a straight-arm plank with hands under shoulders.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Push your hips up and back into an inverted V.
Press your heels toward the floor and lengthen your spine.
Return to plank with control.
Keep moving smoothly for reps.

4564.description: A leg-burning chain of squat, lunge and jump with dumbbells for strength and conditioning.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Do a squat and stand back up.
Step into a lunge on each leg.
Finish with a jump, landing softly with bent knees.
Continue the chain without putting the weights down.
Rest, then repeat the sequence.

4628.description: A seated tuck with a twist, adding oblique work to the dumbbell-loaded crunch.
instructions: Sit on the floor holding a dumbbell at your chest and lean back slightly.
Lift your feet off the floor.
Pull your knees in and rotate your torso to one side.
Extend your legs and rotate back to center.
Repeat on the other side.

4692.description: A kneeling leg movement combining a rear lift with a side kick to work the glutes and hips.
instructions: Start on all fours with a flat back.
Lift one bent knee back and up.
Swing the leg out to the side into a kick.
Return the knee under control.
Switch legs after the set.

4756.description: A sit-up holding a dumbbell against your chest for extra resistance.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet flat or anchored.
Hold a dumbbell against your chest with both hands.
Curl your torso up until you are sitting.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lower back down slowly.

4820.description: A hanging or reclined rollout that drives the knees in under the rings. It strongly trains the lower abs and core.
instructions: Set up in a push-up position with your feet in the ring straps.
Keep your arms straight and shoulders over your hands.
Pull your knees toward your chest by curling your pelvis.
Pause with your hips lifted and abs tight.
Extend your legs back to a straight plank slowly.

4884.description: From a side lying position you swing the top knee out and kick the leg outward. It works the outer hips and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with your hips stacked and bottom leg bent.
Bend the top knee and bring it toward your chest.
Kick the top leg straight out to the side.
Pull the knee back in under control.
Keep your torso still the whole time.
Complete your reps, then switch sides.

4948.description: A one arm lat pulldown from a kneeling position. It builds the lats and tests your core control.
instructions: Kneel facing the cable stack and grab the handle with one hand.
Sit tall with your chest up.
Pull the handle down toward your shoulder.
Squeeze your lat at the bottom.
Let the arm rise back up slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

5076.description: Hold two dumbbells overhead and lunge. The load above you trains balance, core and shoulder stability along with leg strength.
instructions: Press two dumbbells overhead with straight arms.
Step forward into a lunge, lowering your back knee toward the floor.
Keep your core tight and the dumbbells over your shoulders.
Push off the front foot to come back.
Alternate legs each rep.

5204.description: A one-arm overhead press with a resistance band. It trains each shoulder separately and challenges your trunk.
instructions: Stand on the band with the handle in one hand at shoulder height.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.
Press the handle straight overhead.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Lower with control, finish your reps, then switch arms.

5332.description: Press a weight plate away from your chest while squeezing it. A chest isolation move with constant tension.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding a plate between your palms at chest level.
Squeeze your palms together hard.
Press the plate straight up until your arms extend.
Keep squeezing the plate throughout.
Lower it back to your chest slowly.
Keep your feet planted.

5396.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the outer lower leg. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Lie on your side with the roller under your outer lower leg.
Place the roller under the outer lower leg and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from the knee to the ankle.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5460.description: A push-up pushed fast enough for your hands to leave the floor. Builds upper-body power.
instructions: Start in a high plank with hands under shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Push up explosively so your hands lift off.
Land softly with bent elbows.
Go straight into the next rep.
Keep your body in a straight line.

5524.description: One-arm face pull on a cable that trains the rear delts and rotator cuff for healthy shoulders.
instructions: Set a cable at upper chest height with a single handle.
Stand tall and grab the handle with one hand.
Pull toward your face, elbow high and out.
Rotate your hand back slightly at the end.
Return slowly and switch sides after the set.

5844.description: A straight-arm cable pulldown from the side, one arm at a time. It isolates the lats without bending the elbow much.
instructions: Stand facing a high cable with one handle in your hand.
Keep your arm nearly straight and slightly angled.
Pull the handle down toward your thigh by squeezing your lat.
Hold briefly.
Let it rise slowly and switch sides after your set.

5908.description: A seated side bend and twist over one extended leg. Stretches the side body and hamstrings.
instructions: Sit with one leg extended and the other foot against your inner thigh.
Rotate your chest toward the extended leg.
Reach one arm overhead and bend over the leg.
Hold for 5 slow breaths.
Rise and switch sides.

5972.description: A footwork drill through an agility ladder that builds quick feet, rhythm and coordination.
instructions: Lay an agility ladder flat on the ground.
Stand at the start in an athletic stance.
Step quickly with both feet into each square, one after another.
Stay light on the balls of your feet.
Pump your arms and keep your eyes up.
Jog back and repeat for several rounds.

6036.description: A straight-arm pulldown variation that isolates the lats by keeping the elbows nearly straight.
instructions: Stand facing a high cable and grab the bar with straight arms.
Hinge slightly at the hips.
Pull the bar down in an arc to your thighs.
Squeeze your lats.
Return slowly to the start.

6100.description: Skipping without a rope, with light hops and big arm swings. It lifts your heart rate and warms up the legs.
instructions: Stand tall with your feet together.
Step and hop on one foot while driving the opposite knee up.
Swing the opposite arm forward as you hop.
Switch sides in a rhythmic skip.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep going for 30-60 seconds.

6292.description: A deep hip opener on all fours with knees wide. It stretches the inner thighs and groin.
instructions: Start on hands and knees on a mat.
Slide your knees wide, with feet turned out and inline with knees.
Lower onto your forearms.
Push your hips back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.

6356.description: Pulling the handles down from overhead on an outdoor lever machine to build your lats and upper back.
instructions: Sit down and grab the handles overhead.
Lean back very slightly and lift your chest.
Pull the handles down toward your upper chest, driving your elbows down.
Squeeze your back at the bottom.
Let your arms rise slowly until fully stretched, then repeat.

6548.description: Knee raises on a decline bench. The slope adds difficulty and focuses on the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on a decline bench and grip the top behind your head.
Extend your legs with a slight knee bend.
Pull your knees up toward your chest, curling the pelvis off the bench.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your legs slowly without letting the hips drop hard.
Keep the movement smooth, not jerky.

6804.description: From a plank you alternately pull one arm up toward your chest as if climbing. It builds core stability and shoulder control.
instructions: Start in a forearm or high plank with your body in a straight line.
Brace your core and squeeze your glutes.
Pull one arm up and back toward your ribs.
Return it to the floor under control.
Alternate arms without rocking your hips.

7252.description: Raise performed lying face down on an incline bench, hitting the rear delts and the small rotator muscles.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench holding a light dumbbell in one hand.
Let the arm hang straight below your shoulder.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, leading with your elbow, up to shoulder height.
Pause, then lower with control.
Complete your reps and switch sides.

7892.description: A seated overhead extension with a dumbbell that builds the triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands.
Keep your upper arms close to your head.
Lower the weight behind your head by bending your elbows.
Extend your arms back up.
Keep your core tight.
Repeat for the planned reps.

8084.description: A seated concentration curl braced against the thigh with a slow lowering phase. It emphasises the biceps through the negative.
instructions: Sit with your legs apart and hold a weight in one hand.
Rest the back of your upper arm against your inner thigh.
Curl the weight up with help from your other hand if needed.
Lower it very slowly over about 3 to 4 seconds.
Keep your upper arm still against your leg.
Do your reps, then switch arms.

8660.description: A sideways leg press on a sled that targets the glutes and outer hips.
instructions: Position yourself on the sled in a side-facing posture with one foot on the platform.
Brace your core and keep your hips stable.
Push the platform away with the working leg.
Return slowly under control.
Finish the reps, then switch sides.

8916.description: You hop from one side to the other over an imaginary line. It builds lateral agility, leg power and conditioning.
instructions: Stand on two feet with your knees slightly bent.
Hop sideways to one side, landing softly on the balls of your feet.
Immediately hop back to the other side.
Keep your chest up and your hips low.
Use your arms for balance and rhythm.
Go for a set time or a set number of reps.

9044.description: A harder front lever hold with the knees tucked but the hips open. It demands strong lats and core.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Lift your body to horizontal in a tucked position.
Open your hips slightly so your back is flat.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled down.
Hold for 5-10 seconds.
Lower down slowly.

9492.description: An upright row done lying on your back with a cambered bar on a low cable. It hits the delts and traps with steady tension.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet toward a low pulley and grip the SZ bar.
Start with arms extended over your thighs.
Pull the bar up toward your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause when your elbows reach shoulder height.
Lower the bar slowly to the start.

9876.description: A Romanian deadlift on a belt-loaded lever machine using a straight bar. It builds the hamstrings and glutes while sparing the grip and spine from heavy free weight.
instructions: Step into the machine, set the belt securely and hold the straight bar with an overhand grip.
Stand tall with your knees slightly bent and your chest up.
Push your hips back and slide the bar down along your thighs.
Lower until you feel a strong hamstring stretch while your back stays flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand back up.
Squeeze your glutes at the top without leaning back.

9940.description: A forward lunge holding a sandbag at your chest or on your shoulders. The awkward load challenges your legs and core.
instructions: Hold a sandbag against your chest or across your shoulders and stand tall.
Step forward with one leg into a long stride.
Lower until both knees are about 90 degrees with your torso upright.
Push through the front foot to return to standing.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep your front knee over your ankle and the bag tight to your body.

10196.description: A chained set of dumbbell shoulder moves done without rest, building shoulder strength and endurance.
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Do a set of lateral raises, then straight into front raises.
Move into a set of overhead presses without putting the weights down.
Lower the dumbbells under control and rest.
Keep the weights light and your torso still throughout.

10388.description: A standing overhead press using a sandbag, which shifts as you push, so your shoulders and core must stay tight.
instructions: Hold a sandbag at your upper chest or shoulders.
Stand with feet hip width apart and brace your core.
Press the bag straight overhead.
Lock out the arms, then lower the bag with control.
Keep your ribs down and avoid leaning back.

11092.description: A kneeling rotational move with a landmine bar, swinging it in a wide arc side to side. It builds strong, rotating abs.
instructions: Kneel facing the landmine and hold the end of the bar with both hands in front of your chest.
Keep your hips squared and core tight.
Swing the bar in an arc to one side by rotating your torso.
Swing across to the other side in a controlled sweep.
Keep a steady rhythm for the set.

11284.description: A lying chest fly with a kettlebell, alternating arms. It trains the chest and challenges your control.
instructions: Lie on your back holding a kettlebell over your chest in one hand.
Keep a soft bend in your elbow.
Lower the kettlebell out to the side in an arc.
Bring it back over your chest.
Switch hands and alternate.

11796.description: A gentle shoulder mobility drill for external rotation.
instructions: Stand tall with your elbow bent to 90 degrees at your side.
Rotate your forearm outward away from your belly.
Keep your elbow tucked in.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

0020.description: Standing on a balance board to challenge stability. Improves balance and wakes up the muscles of the legs and ankles.
instructions: Place the balance board on a flat surface.
Step onto the balance board with one foot, ensuring it is centered.
Slowly shift your weight onto the foot on the balance board, keeping your core engaged.
Maintain your balance and stability as you hold the position for a desired amount of time.
Repeat the exercise with the other foot.
instructionsZh: 将平衡板放在平坦的表面上。
用一只脚踩在平衡板上，确保其居中。
慢慢地将体重转移到平衡板上的脚上，保持核心肌群参与。
在保持该姿势所需的时间内保持平衡和稳定。
用另一只脚重复该练习。

0084.description: Kneeling, you roll the barbell forward and pull it back in. A demanding exercise for the abs.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and hold a barbell with both hands, shoulder-width apart.
Roll the barbell forward, extending your arms and keeping your core engaged.
Continue rolling forward until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Pause for a moment, then slowly roll the barbell back towards your knees, maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 跪在地板上，双手握住杠铃，距离与肩同宽。
向前滚动杠铃，伸展手臂并保持核心收紧。
继续向前滚动，直到身体完全伸展并且手臂举过头顶。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃向膝盖方向滚动，保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

0148.description: A cable shoulder press alternating arms. Trains the delts and triceps.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and grasp the handles of the cable machine with an overhand grip.
Position your hands at shoulder height, with your palms facing forward.
Keep your core engaged and your back straight.
Press one handle up and forward until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
Alternate between arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，并用正手握住绳索机的手柄。
将双手放在与肩同高的位置，手掌朝前。
保持核心参与并保持背部挺直。
向上并向前按下一个手柄，直到您的手臂完全伸展。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
用另一只手臂重复上述步骤。
双臂交替进行所需的重复次数。

0212.description: A seated cable crunch with the handle behind the head. You curl the torso forward against the pull to work the abs.
instructions: Sit on a cable machine with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent.
Hold the cable handle with both hands and position it behind your head.
Engage your abs and slowly curl your upper body forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在缆绳机上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲。
用双手握住电缆手柄并将其放在脑后。
收紧腹肌，慢慢向前弯曲上半身，使胸部靠近膝盖。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0276.description: A core drill where you extend opposite arm and leg while keeping the lower back pressed to the floor. It builds stability in the abs.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended towards the ceiling.
Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, creating a 90-degree angle at your hips and knees.
Engage your core and lower back to press your lower back into the ground.
Slowly lower your right arm and left leg towards the ground, keeping them straight and hovering just above the floor.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your left arm and right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双臂伸向天花板。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿抬离地面，使臀部和膝盖形成 90 度角。
接合你的核心和下背部，将你的下背部压入地面。
慢慢地将右臂和左腿放低至地面，保持它们伸直并悬停在地板上方。
暂停片刻，然后回到起始位置。
用左臂和右腿重复该动作。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

0340.description: A lying press with the palms facing each other. It works the chest and arms with a shoulder-friendly grip.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other and arms extended straight up.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌相对，双臂伸直向上。
将哑铃放低至胸部两侧，保持肘部呈 90 度角。
将哑铃推回到起始位置，充分伸展手臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0404.description: Seated, you press dumbbells overhead with palms facing each other. A shoulder-friendly press for the shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双手各握一个哑铃，掌心向内。
将哑铃举至肩高，肘部弯曲，手掌朝前。
向上推哑铃，直到手臂完全伸过头顶。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回肩部高度。
重复所需的重复次数。

0468.description: A push-up where one knee swings under the body toward the opposite elbow. It combines chest work with core and hip mobility.
instructions: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders.
Lower your chest toward the floor and bring one knee toward the opposite elbow.
Push back up while returning the leg.
Repeat with the other leg.
Keep your core tight.
Move at a steady pace.

0532.description: You pass a kettlebell in a figure 8 pattern around and between your legs. It trains the core, hips and grip while keeping you moving.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a kettlebell in one hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Pass the kettlebell between your legs, switching hands as it reaches the back of your legs.
As the kettlebell comes forward, pass it to the other hand between your legs.
Continue passing the kettlebell between your legs in a figure 8 motion.
Maintain a steady pace and engage your core throughout the exercise.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，一只手握住壶铃。
稍微弯曲膝盖，髋部向前转动，保持背部挺直。
将壶铃放在双腿之间，当壶铃到达双腿后部时交换双手。
当壶铃向前移动时，将其传递到两腿之间的另一只手。
继续以 8 字形动作将壶铃传递到双腿之间。
在整个练习过程中保持稳定的节奏并调动核心力量。
重复所需的重复次数。

0596.description: Seated on a machine, you bring the handles together in front of you with arms nearly straight. Isolates the chest.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the machine with your back against the pad.
Grasp the handles with a pronated grip and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Exhale and push the handles forward, bringing them together in front of your chest.
Pause for a moment, squeezing your chest muscles.
Inhale and slowly return to the starting position, allowing your chest muscles to stretch.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整座椅高度并将自己放在机器上，背部靠在垫子上。
旋前抓住手柄，并保持肘部稍微弯曲。
呼气并将手柄向前推，将它们放在胸前。
暂停片刻，挤压胸部肌肉。
吸气并慢慢回到起始位置，让胸部肌肉伸展。
重复所需的重复次数。

0660.description: A close grip push-up with your hands on dumbbells. Puts extra focus on the triceps and gives a deeper range.
instructions: Start in a push-up position with your hands placed close together, directly under your shoulders.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, resting them on the ground.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从俯卧撑位置开始，双手并拢，直接放在肩膀下方。
每只手握住一个哑铃，将其放在地上。
弯曲肘部，使肘部靠近身体两侧，将身体降低到地面。
推动手掌以伸展手臂并返回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0724.description: A leg-up hip lift with a rotation. It works the lower abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight up.
Press your arms into the floor.
Lift your hips and rotate them to one side.
Lower slowly.
Repeat to the other side.
Keep legs straight.

0788.description: A standing barbell press from behind the neck to overhead. It builds the shoulders and triceps and calls for good shoulder mobility.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell behind your neck with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Press the barbell overhead by extending your arms, fully extending your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，用正手握法将杠铃握在颈后。
保持背部挺直，核心参与。
伸展手臂，充分伸展肘部，将杠铃推过头顶。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0852.description: A squat with weight held at the chest or shoulders. It builds the glutes and thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest or on your shoulders.
Engage your core and keep your chest up as you lower your hips down and back, as if sitting into a chair.
Lower until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Push through your heels to stand back up, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
将重物放在胸前或肩膀上。
收紧核心并保持挺胸，同时降低臀部和向后倾斜，就像坐在椅子上一样。
降低直到大腿与地面平行，或者尽可能降低到您能舒服的高度。
推动脚后跟站起来，在顶部挤压臀部。
重复所需的重复次数。

0980.description: A bent-over hip extension with a band, kicking one leg back. It trains the glutes.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at ankle height.
Stand facing away from the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Step back to create tension in the band, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at the hips and lean forward, maintaining a neutral spine.
Extend your right leg straight back, squeezing your glutes at the top.
Lower your right leg back down and repeat with the left leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在脚踝高度的坚固锚点上。
背对锚点站立，双脚与肩同宽。
向后退一步，在弹力带上产生张力，保持膝盖稍微弯曲。
铰接臀部并向前倾斜，保持脊柱中立。
将右腿向后伸直，在顶部挤压臀部。
将右腿放回原位，然后换左腿重复此动作。
继续交替双腿达到所需的重复次数。
